visualCharacteristics.purpose: Stack of full-bleed photo rows with a dark side gradient and a white text column
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed 550px photo rows, dark gradient on the text side, alternating text left/right

contentPattern.structure: one row per photo row: photo cell | text cell (h2 with <em> for the blue word, paragraphs, bold CTA link); cell order sets the text side

usage: Alternating full-bleed photo and text rows on about pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse alt-row for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
